description: Why the trader closed a position, in one code (TJ-9E). The trader writes the exit in their own words; a night-only local model reads those words and DRAFTS one code from this list, with the exact span of the note that made it choose. A draft is provisional until the trader presses Confirm or Correct. These codes are REPORTED: no detector, score, alert, watchlist, Focus list, review queue or review policy file reads one, and no outcome, R statistic or verdict ever selects, ranks or pre-fills one. Codes are permanent identifiers: a code is never renamed and never reused for a different meaning, because rows already written carry it, and a later list ships as exit_reasons_v2.json beside this file.

reasons.label: Target hit
reasons.hint: It reached the price you were aiming for and you took it.

reasons.label: Stop hit
reasons.hint: It reached the level that said you were wrong.

reasons.label: Trailed out
reasons.hint: You were following it up (or down) and the trail took you out.

reasons.label: Time stop
reasons.hint: It had had long enough to work and had not, so you let it go.

reasons.label: The thesis broke
reasons.hint: The reason you were in it stopped being true - the level, the trend or the story.

reasons.label: Took profit early
reasons.hint: You were green and banked it before the plan said to.

reasons.label: Protecting gains
reasons.hint: It was giving back an open profit and you closed to keep what was left.

reasons.label: Needed the capital
reasons.hint: You wanted the buying power somewhere else.

reasons.label: News or an event
reasons.hint: Something happened - a headline, an earnings date, a halt - and you stepped out.

reasons.label: End of day
reasons.hint: You were flat by the close because it was a day trade, not because of the tape.

reasons.label: Assigned or expired
reasons.hint: The position closed itself: an option expired, or you were assigned.

reasons.label: Too much risk on
reasons.hint: The position, or the book, was bigger than you wanted to carry.

reasons.label: Something else
reasons.hint: None of the above. The words you wrote are still the record.
